error_reason: The Planner agent repeatedly issues identical or nearly identical search instructions to the WebSurfer (e.g., 'The Ganymede Takeover author 1967') across Turns 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, and 13. In all instances, the WebSurfer returns the same unhelpful search results (DuckDuckGo homepage or download prompts). Despite the repeated failures to retrieve actual data, the Planner continues to generate the same failed search queries instead of adapting its strategy, refining the query, switching to a different source type, or concluding the task based on its internal knowledge (as confirmed in Turn 0). This represents a rigid loop of ineffective steps.

Once Turn 3 identifies the authors via a single search, the agent should immediately verify using internal knowledge rather than looping with identical search queries that fail to update the session context.
